changes.cross_build: Metric-dependent helpers, tests, and callers are host-guarded. No dummy metric definitions.
changes.input: Empty basic drafts end their open row. Unresolved prefixes are escaped before submission without changing raw answers. Appends require one compatible mutation since the last paint plus prepared-prefix validation.
changes.boundaries: Fixed native stdout/stderr records share row, pending separator, and generation state across context-aware and standalone output. No process-lifetime controller pointers. Failed inspection discards geometry without discarding confirmed identity or delivered guidance.
changes.warnings: Atomic new/retry kind bits allow a first attempt on the existing poll while failed retries remain gated by real UI events or final quiescence. Retaining surfaces must explicitly separate admission from refresh. Partial duplicates remain accepted.
changes.tests: Replacement PTYs use a different width and separately gated append/deletion stages with exact row/prompt/cursor assertions.
